Case files from the Moon and Mars

Space Sleuths

Some machines went silent. Some never came home.

NASA has left machines all over the Moon and Mars. Open their case files, study the clues, and find out what happened to each one, and what they discovered.

TOP SECRET
Message from Mission Control

Welcome, Detective.

Since the 1960s, NASA has sent machines to explore the Moon and Mars. Many of them are still out there today.

Some went silent. Some were left behind on purpose. And one of them might surprise you.

Your mission: open each case file, inspect every clue, and make your best guess about what happened. Then uncover the real story and the science each machine made possible.

Good luck, Space Sleuth.

These machines were left behind, but never forgotten. Every one of them taught us something new and helped the next mission go further. Maybe one day, you will build the next one.
